title: n8n-io/n8n
claim: n8n-io/n8n — Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host
why_good: A fair-code workflow-automation platform with native AI and self-host — genuinely strong, but n8n is already a funded, scaled company, not an opening.
value: n8n already monetizes (cloud + enterprise); for a founder it's a competitor/benchmark, not a gap to fill.
risk: Established and funded; a category signal — the opportunity is adjacent niches, not cloning n8n.

zh.claim: n8n-io/n8n —— fair-code 的工作流自动化平台,原生 AI、可自托管。
zh.why_good: 一个 fair-code、原生 AI、可自托管的工作流自动化平台——确实强,但 n8n 已是拿了钱、规模化的公司,不是口子。
zh.value: n8n 已在变现(云 + 企业版);对创始人它是竞品/标杆,不是待填的空白。
zh.risk: 成熟且有融资;这里当品类信号列出——机会在相邻细分,不是复制 n8n。
